articles.title: Trump rejects Mamdani threat to arrest Israel’s Netanyahu for war crimes
articles.description: US president insists Netanyahu will not be arrested, despite ICC warrant.

articles.title: Trump says Netanyahu won't be arrested in New York, pushing back on Mamdani
articles.description: Israel's prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, is the target of an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court related to the war on Gaza.

articles.title: AMD launches Helios, its first rack AI system to rival Nvidia, adding Microsoft as newest buyer
articles.description: AMD is taking aim at Nvidia with Helios, its first AI rack system, and has landed Microsoft as a new customer, joining Meta, OpenAI and Oracle.
